name: Alice
source:
"Hehehe. It's almost as if you've stumbled into Wonderland."

Despair and desire go hand in hand.

A member of the Ludens, a mysterious group of beings that suddenly appear in World's Odyssey. She is the Agent of Desire, who often speaks for the rest of the Ludens. Her peaceful demeanor might trick you into thinking she's approachable, but she has a tendency to look down upon others.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
